rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for nighttime and the general period after nightfall.

example.english: At night, don't walk down this road alone.
example.traditional: 夜晚唔好自己一個人行呢條路。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 m4 hou2 zi6 gei2 jat1 go3 jan4 haang4 ni1 tiu4 lou6

rows.note: Use this for one countable night spent out doing something or staying somewhere.

example.english: We stayed at the hotel for one night.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hai2 zau2 dim3 zyu6 zo2 jat1 maan5

rows.note: Use this when the focus is the darkness of night rather than the time period itself.

example.english: In the darkness of night, you can't see anything clearly.
example.traditional: 黑夜入面，乜都睇唔清楚。
example.jyutping: hak1 je6 jap6 min6 mat1 dou1 tai2 m4 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use this for the onset of night, rather than for the whole nighttime period.

example.english: After night fell, the streets became much quieter.
example.traditional: 入夜之後，街上就靜咗好多。
example.jyutping: jap6 je6 zi1 hau6 gaai1 soeng6 zau6 zing6 zo2 hou2 do1
